blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Shifting from individual political attacks towards government transparency and comprehensive reforms has become more urgent in light of the ongoing oil crisis and worsening corruption that have taken an economic toll on the Philippines. “Corruption is more than a political issue. It’s a moral one. It’s the people who suffer from the misappropriation of public funds. This is the primary reason why our countrymen continue to be poor. The heavy crisis that citizens cannot be addressed for as long as their pockets are being dipped into,” Legarda said in Filipino in a statement issued on Friday. Citing recent […]...
